name: io.github.python1/verified-memory
title: Verified Memory
description: Read-only, offline search over a checksum-verified memory pack, with exact cited quotes

packageArguments.name: --pack
packageArguments.description: Absolute path to a pack directory containing exactly MEMORY.md, README.md, records.jsonl and SHA256SUMS. The whole pack is verified at startup; the server refuses to start if any check fails.
